summary: Decodes one 16-bit packed color value (RGB 5:6:5) into four floats written through the result pointer: R and B use the 0.032258064 scale, G uses the 0.015873017 scale, and alpha is forced to 1.0. Free helper with no instance state; the callers are texture filtering and keyframe quad interpolation.

operations.description: Decode red channel: result[0] = ((unsigned __int16)a2 >> 11) * flt_5ACCD4 (5-bit red scaled by 0.032258064).
Decode green channel: result[1] = ((a2 >> 5) & 0x3F) * flt_5ACCDC (6-bit green scaled by 0.015873017).
Decode blue channel: result[2] = (a2 & 0x1F) * flt_5ACCD4 (5-bit blue scaled by 0.032258064).
Set alpha channel: result[3] = 1.0, always opaque.
Return the result pointer for chaining.
